name: Urban Transportation Systems Planning
description: Introduction to urban transportation systems; urban transportation issues; introduction to transportation planning; concept of demand and supply; transportation costs and basic economic concepts; introduction to travel demand modelling; four-stage travel demand models; data requirements for four-stage modelling; trip generation, trip distribution, and modal split modelling; introduction to transportation networks; shortest path algorithms; traffic assignment methods; free/all-or-nothing method; multi-path assignment method; capacity restrained traffic assignment method; equilibrium traffic assignment; introduction to land use transport models; transportation project evaluation; sustainable transportation planning.
